envelope.description: A failed last-indexed read and a failed lookup are named pipeline causes with their own codes

body.title: A failed last-indexed read and a failed lookup are named pipeline causes with their own codes
body.summary: PIPELINE_CAUSES gains 'index-state-read-failed' and 'lookup-failed', with ShaperIndexStateReadError and ShaperLookupFailedError and one case each in errorForPipelineCause. tryExplorationPipeline catches the awaited steps.lastIndexedAt and steps.executePlan; runShaper's own freshness reads go through the same injectable reader (PipelineSteps.lastIndexedAt). Both classifyShaperError mappings (src/daemon/analyze-rpc.ts and src/analyze/orchestrator/driver.ts) map them to their codes; AnalyzeRpcErrorCode and RunErrorCode gain the two codes. Grounding: runShaper reads the freshness watermark directly through resolveRepoLastIndexedAt at src/analyze/context/driver.ts:357 (outside the injectable reader); the pipeline reads it through steps.lastIndexedAt at :1471 and awaits executePlan bare at :1473. t4 routes the :357 read through PipelineSteps.lastIndexedAt (REAL_PIPELINE_STEPS declared at :1582; its lastIndexedAt member binds resolveRepoLastIndexedAt at :1587). The two new causes are added to the expected map of src/analyze/context/__tests__/pipeline-outcome.test.ts (asserted at :418)..
acceptanceChecks: A lastIndexedAt that throws ends as ShaperIndexStateReadError (code 'index-state-read-failed') at runShaper's freshness read and inside the pipeline.
An executePlan that throws ends as ShaperLookupFailedError (code 'lookup-failed'); every PIPELINE_CAUSES member has exactly one case in errorForPipelineCause.
runAnalyze ends with 'index-state-read-failed' / 'lookup-failed' for these causes, never 'internal-error'.

tests.name: runShaper: a lastIndexedAt that throws ends as ShaperIndexStateReadError (code 'index-state-read-failed'), through the one injectable reader (PipelineSteps.lastIndexedAt), at runShaper's freshness read and inside the pipeline
pipeline: an executePlan that throws ends as ShaperLookupFailedError (code 'lookup-failed'); PIPELINE_CAUSES and errorForPipelineCause have one case per member
classifyShaperError: index-state-read-failed and lookup-failed map to their own codes in both mappings
runAnalyze: index-state-read-failed and lookup-failed end with their own codes, not internal-error
